entities.summary: Patrice Michaud (b. 1980-11-01, Cap-Chat) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Cap-Chat and Canada. Known in the fields of canada, composers & musicians, americas.
